article.title: 〜ぬ negación literaria/fija
article.chapter: Gramática literaria y clásica para reconocimiento — 文語・古典文法の認識

claims.summary: In its negative reading, ぬ is the attributive form of classical negative auxiliary ず, attaches to 未然形 and is chiefly literary or fixed in standard Japanese; ない is ordinarily used for negation in common standard speech, with a documented western dialect exception.

claims.sectionKey: Cómo distinguirla de la forma completiva
claims.summary: A distinct completive auxiliary ぬ attaches to 連用形 and expresses completion; the negative ぬ attaches to 未然形, so the preceding form distinguishes the homographs.

claims.sectionKey: Cómo distinguirla de la forma completiva
claims.summary: Digital Daijisen gives 夏の夜はまだ宵ながら明けぬるを as an example of completive ぬ.

locator.description: Kotobank, デジタル大辞泉, lines 14–23: negative ぬ is the adnominal form of classical ず, attaches to 未然形, forms and examples, and register/dialect qualification. 精選版 日本国語大辞典, lines 61–64: negative use and dated examples.

links.notes: Retains the source’s explicit western-dialect exception; does not generalize to all Japanese varieties.

locator.description: Kotobank, デジタル大辞泉, lines 24–32: separate completive ぬ paradigm attaches to 連用形 and expresses completion; the negative auxiliary above attaches to 未然形, lines 15–17.

links.notes: The contrast is based on the forms and definitions in the same dictionary entry.

locator.description: National Institute for Japanese Language and Linguistics, lines 45–49 and 67–75: identifies classical ぬ as a completive auxiliary and explains its completion/result-state reading with 秋来ぬ.

links.notes: Used to independently confirm the completive reading, not the negative auxiliary.

locator.description: Kotobank, デジタル大辞泉, lines 26–29: exact example 夏の夜はまだ宵ながら明けぬるを is listed under completive ぬ.

links.notes: Quoted exactly from the dictionary entry.
